definitions.gloss: white sugar; refined sugar; granulated white sugar
definitions.explanation: Refined sugar that has been processed to remove molasses and impurities, resulting in white crystals. The most commonly used type of sugar in everyday Japanese cooking and baking.

examples.japanese: {白砂糖|しろざとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大|おお}さじ→大さじ：22527_oosaji⟧{二杯|にはい}⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: Add two tablespoons of white sugar.

examples.japanese: ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{白砂糖|しろざとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{控|ひか}えている→控える：10054_hikaeru⟧。
examples.english: I'm cutting back on white sugar for my health.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦レシピ→レシピ：07157_reshipi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{白砂糖|しろざとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{代|か}わり→代わり：01296_kawari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{黒砂糖|くろざとう}→黒砂糖：18292_kurozatou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: In this recipe, you can use brown sugar instead of white sugar.

notes:
The standard term for refined white sugar used in cooking and baking. In Japan, the most common form of 白砂糖 is ⟦{上白糖|じょうはくとう}→上白糖：25163_jouhakutou⟧, a fine-grained sugar with slightly higher moisture content than Western granulated sugar, giving it a softer texture.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {白砂糖|しろざとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加|くわ}える→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧: to add white sugar
- {白砂糖|しろざとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{控|ひか}える→控える：10054_hikaeru⟧: to cut back on white sugar
- {白砂糖|しろざとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{代|か}わり→代わり：01296_kawari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: instead of white sugar
- {白砂糖|しろざとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{摂|せっ}り{過|す}ぎ: overconsumption of white sugar

TYPES OF SUGAR IN JAPAN:
- ⟦{上白糖|じょうはくとう}→上白糖：25163_jouhakutou⟧: fine white sugar (most common in Japanese households)
- ⟦グラニュー{糖|とう}→グラニュー糖：23996_guranyuutou⟧: granulated sugar (coarser, used in sweets)
- ⟦{黒砂糖|くろざとう}→黒砂糖：18292_kurozatou⟧: brown/raw sugar (unrefined, from Okinawa)
- ⟦{三温糖|さんおんとう}→三温糖：23597_sanontou⟧: light brown sugar (slightly less refined)
- ⟦{氷砂糖|こおりざとう}→氷砂糖：22930_koorizatou⟧: rock sugar (used for making fruit liqueurs)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{黒砂糖|くろざとう}→黒砂糖：18292_kurozatou⟧: brown sugar, raw sugar — unrefined sugar with a stronger flavor
- ⟦{砂糖|さとう}→砂糖：00884_satou⟧: sugar — the general term for all types of sugar
- ⟦{甘味料|かんみりょう}→甘味料：18192_kanmiryou⟧: sweetener — broader term including artificial sweeteners
